title: Warren Buffett Steps Down as Berkshire Hathaway Chairman
description: “Father Time always wins,” the 96-year-old, who turned Berkshire Hathaway into an investing powerhouse, said in a letter to shareholders. He will remain on the board as chairman emeritus.
author: Michael J. de la Merced

title: Two Centuries On, Smithsonian Connects Jefferson’s Hair to Hemings’s Children
description: A new book describes how cutting-edge genomics techniques yielded “extraordinary proof” that Thomas Jefferson fathered children with Sally Hemings.
author: Jennifer Schuessler

title: How Trump Has Disrupted National Parks
description: Maintenance projects have been put off around the country and resources diverted to the president’s favored projects in Washington.
author: Maxine Joselow

title: Kennedy Center Supporters Rally Amid Fears of Trump’s Demolition
description: Photos of President Trump reviewing a poster board with the title “Kennedy Center DEMOLISHED” spurred the largest gathering yet in support of the performing arts institution.
author: Chris Cameron

title: Trump Says He Has Banned CNN, MS NOW and Politico From White House
description: The president cited reporting from the outlets that he deemed “fake news.” It was unclear how such a ban would be enforced or defended in court.
author: Michael M. Grynbaum and Benjamin Mullin

title: A Central African Hotel Has Become a Nightmare Prison for U.S. Deportees
description: Witnesses say men were hooded and beaten in Equatorial Guinea. The autocratic government there is a partner in President Trump’s deportation program.
author: Megha Rajagopalan and Pranav Baskar

title: Building ‘Trump Class’ Battleships Will Be a Big, Expensive Mistake
description: The United States needs a bigger Navy. But not one that looks like this.
author: Steve Cohen

title: Russia Aims to Inject Chaos Into Elections, U.S. Intelligence Finds
description: The Kremlin is once again seeking to undermine confidence in American democracy with online influence campaigns, U.S. officials said.
author: Dustin Volz, Julian E. Barnes and Steven Lee Myers

title: A.G. Sulzberger: The Story of America, Told in 15 Million First Drafts of History
description: The Times has witnessed the country’s transformation. It will keep its eyes open.
author: A.G. Sulzberger

title: Why Israel Fears This Searing New Documentary
description: It’s hard to tell whether Israelis are enraged by “NAZA” because they think it’s full of lies, or because they know or fear it’s true.
author: Michelle Goldberg

title: Trump Calls A.I. Fears a Hoax. Inside the White House, the Debate Is More Complex.
description: The president seems driven chiefly by the sense that A.I. is the way to economic growth, and nothing can be allowed to stand in its way.
author: David E. Sanger, Jonathan Swan, Cecilia Kang and Dustin Volz

title: Blanche’s Political Campaigning Breaks an Ethical Norm Going Back to Watergate
description: The attorney general’s campaign politicking for Republicans adds to the degradation of post-Watergate values at the Justice Department.
author: Charlie Savage

title: F.B.I. Temporarily Halted Cooperation With Canada Over References to 9/11
description: The abrupt move by Kash Patel, the bureau’s director, came as President Trump was ramping up his attacks on the country.
author: Maggie Haberman, Jane Bradley, Jonathan Swan, Adam Goldman and Matina Stevis-Gridneff

title: German Art Institutions Prepare for a Fight as Far Right Looks to Take Power
description: As the Alternative for Germany party seeks to control a state government for the first time, its push for “patriotic” art has drawn comparisons with Nazi policies.
author: Jim Tankersley and Sam Gurwitt

title: Will A.I. Kill Us? Can It Hack My Bank Account? Your A.I. Questions Answered
description: Nearly 1,000 readers sent us their questions about artificial intelligence, its potential and its potential risks.
author: Cade Metz, Dylan Freedman and K. R. Callaway

title: Why the Iran War Will Make Heating Oil More Expensive for Some This Winter
description: The cost of heating oil, which is similar to diesel and used extensively in Northeastern states, has climbed sharply because of the war in Iran.
author: Aruni Soni

title: China Stockpiled Oil, and Now It Could Dominate the Energy Landscape
description: The war with Iran revealed just how much influence the world’s biggest oil importer has over prices and other countries’ supplies of jet fuel, gasoline and diesel.
author: Rebecca F. Elliott and Keith Bradsher

title: Trump Moves Ahead With F-35 Jet Sales to Saudi Arabia Despite Intelligence Concerns
description: U.S. intelligence agencies have warned in internal reports that China could acquire or steal U.S. warplane technology if F-35 jets are sent to Saudi Arabia.
author: Edward Wong

title: Trump Air Force One Photos Fuel Kennedy Center Demolition Speculation
description: Images captured through the windows of Air Force One showed President Trump reviewing a poster with the title “Kennedy Center DEMOLISHED.”
author: Shawn McCreesh

title: The Face of London in the 1960s Is Living Her Best Life
description: The face of London in the 1960s is living her best life at the age of 77.
author: Rhonda Garelick
